disclaimer: Cohort sizes and odds ratios are illustrative. ROGEN sample size and design are not fixed. Frequencies are from public reference populations, not from Romanian data.

allele_counts.source: cache fields ac_nfe and an_nfe for the cached gnomAD variant_id

tsi_vs_nfe.wording: differs between public reference panels (1000G TSI vs gnomAD NFE)
tsi_vs_nfe.test: two-sided Fisher exact, or Pearson chi-square when every expected count is >= 5
tsi_vs_nfe.descriptive_column: tsi_nfe_maf_abs_diff_gt_0_05_descriptive is the absolute MAF gap > 0.05. It is not a test.
tsi_vs_nfe.tsi_allele_number: sum of Ensembl allele_count for 1000GENOMES:phase_3:TSI when returned
tsi_vs_nfe.tsi_allele_number_assumption: 2 x 107 (1000 Genomes phase 3 TSI sample size) when Ensembl does not return TSI allele counts

frequency_policy: gnomAD v4 NFE and each 1000 Genomes phase 3 EUR subpopulation are stored separately. They are not averaged, and none is labeled as a Romanian frequency.

power.design: 1:1 case-control, two-sided allelic z-test, normal approximation
